lesson: Deterministic replay validates recorded events and state transitions against the recorded journal. Replay NEVER invokes a tool and never makes a model call, so it does not repeat a write and does not re-run inference. It verifies that a recorded run is internally consistent and reproducible from the plan, policy, sources, registry and workspace identity it recorded. Live model inference is not guaranteed deterministic, so a fresh call may differ from a recorded one. Session coaching and promoted memory improve the harness and its guidance; they do not update model weights.
